name: Akaashi
excerpt: A quiet and focused photography student who becomes involved with Bokuto and is the father of Kageyama Tobio.
notes:
Akaashi is a photography student who visits Nekoma's coffeeshop and catches Bokuto's attention. He is initially indifferent to Bokuto's advances but later asks him to model for a photography project. Akaashi is characterized by his quiet demeanor and dedication to photography. Over time, he develops a friendship with Bokuto, which hints at deeper feelings.

Akaashi is revealed to be a part-time chef and the father of Kageyama. He plays volleyball with Bokuto and their sons, showcasing his skills as a setter.

Akaashi is a part-time chef and the father of Kageyama Tobio. He is described as having sharp features and is admired by Bokuto. Akaashi plays volleyball and has a polite demeanor, especially when playing with the children.
